name: Paraco Gas
notes: Researched from public paracogas.com pages (Account Benefits, FAQ, Monthly Budget, Support) and the public myaccount.paracogas.com sign-in page only; no sign-in, no sign-up, no forms submitted. Sign-in is Email Address + Password with a Sign in button, 'Need a new user profile? Sign up here.' and 'Forgot your password? Reset password here.' No MFA is described. Automatic payment has two forms: Direct Pay (checking, drafted within 10 business days of the service) and Easy Pay (credit card, charged on the statement date); enrollment in My Account or with a paper authorization form, credit-approved customers only. Cancel steps are not published (autopay_cancel inferred). Text to Pay/Order via 1-855-589-4427 is announced on the sign-in page. Smart Pay budget: 10 months, $29.99 + tax admin fee, 250+ gallons/yr and 2+ deliveries, COD/will-call excluded, sign-up by calling 800-447-3835 or a lead form. No late, card or returned-payment fees are published, so none are modelled; closing an account is not documented publicly, so cancel_service is left at the family default. Independent review 2026-10-09: FAQ, Monthly Budget and Account Benefits pages re-checked (Direct Pay 10 business days, Easy Pay on statement date, credit approval, no charge, P.O. Box 845736, $75/$150 delivery, Smart Pay 10 months/$29.99/250 gal/2 deliveries, 800-447-3835). Removed the claim that customer service sets up third-party notification (the page does not say how) and the senior/Hometown Hero sentence from the budget article (those discounts are on Account Benefits, not the budget page). Review 2026-10-09 (2): the inferred autopay_cancel note was removed from the capability because supported-capability notes render on the AutoPay page as if the biller said them; the inference is recorded here instead.

help.title: Ways to pay Paraco Gas
paragraphs: Sign in to My Account to pay online. Paraco takes checks, cash and Visa, MasterCard, Discover and American Express.

You can also text 1-855-589-4427 to pay (Text to Pay) or to order a delivery, or mail a check to Paraco Gas Corporation, P.O. Box 845736, Boston, MA 02284-5736. Your account number is on the delivery ticket, in the top-right remittance area of a statement or invoice, or at the top left of a service work order.

help.title: Automatic Payment: Direct Pay and Easy Pay
paragraphs: Direct Pay takes your balance from your checking account within 10 business days of the service. Easy Pay charges your balance to your credit card on the statement date.
Enroll through My Account or ask customer service for an authorization form. There is no charge, but you must be a credit-approved customer.

help.title: Invoices and statements
paragraphs: Paraco invoices are available by email or in My Account. If you have an outstanding balance you also get a monthly statement.

help.title: Smart Pay budget billing
paragraphs: Smart Pay spreads your yearly propane cost over 10 monthly payments based on your average use. To qualify you must use more than 250 gallons a year with at least two deliveries; COD and will-call customers are not eligible. There is a $29.99 administration fee plus tax.
Call 800-447-3835 to sign up. For general account questions call customer service at 800-647-4427.

help.title: Third Party Notification Service
paragraphs: You can name a relative, friend or agency to be told if your heating service is about to be shut off for an unpaid bill. Contact customer service at 800-647-4427 for details.

help.title: Delivery and equipment charges
paragraphs: Next-day delivery costs $75 plus tax and same-day delivery $150 plus tax. A separate Safety and Maintenance (ECC) charge covers compliance costs such as insurance and permits, and a restocking fee covers disconnecting and restocking equipment.
